spec.text: Image 1 is the man's character model sheet; image 2 is the woman's character model sheet; image 3 is the same village already drawn in the approved style (keep its houses and its blue-green Taipei 101 identical); image 4 is a real photo of the village houses' colorful doors and windows; image 5 is the approved art style (sculpted matte clay figurines placed in a painted storybook set). Golden dusk at Four Four South Village. This is the SAME place as image 3: the same old grey two-story village houses with the same green, blue and red doors and windows, the same tall blue-green Taipei 101 rising behind them, drawn in exactly the same style, only the time of day changes to a warm pink and gold dusk sky with the house windows starting to glow. On the open paved square in front, the woman and the man sit back to back on the ground, laughing and leaning their weight against each other. Every character is a dimensional sculpted matte clay figurine exactly like the people in the art-style image, about four heads tall, adult, never a flat 2D drawing; mouths closed in small gentle smiles. the man keeps EXACTLY his model-sheet look: black rectangular glasses, short swept black hair, navy cotton overshirt worn open over a white crewneck T-shirt, khaki chinos, white canvas sneakers, black backpack; the woman keeps EXACTLY her model-sheet look: half-up princess-style wavy dark-brown hair with twisted strands at the back, oatmeal knit sweater, sage-green pleated midi skirt, white low sneakers, small tan leather crossbody bag. Recreate any real place in the same warm matte clay and gouache storybook style. Cinematic composition. Any signs, plaques or screens are blank; no readable text and no logos. No other people. No photorealism, no glossy plastic.
